# Agency rating histories (primary sources)

Saved 2026-10-15 from the agencies' own public pages (rendered HTML captured by hand, parsed to the CSVs here; the HTML itself is not kept).

- `moodys_italy_rating_actions.csv`: the "Rating Action" documents on https://ratings.moodys.com/ratings/423690 (Italy, Government of; Issuer tab, document list). Dates and headline only; ratings and outlooks come from the headlines. The three 2010-2011 rows about the EFSF and the 2012-02-13 "adjusts ratings of 9 European sovereigns" row are not Italy-specific changes with a stated Italian rating and are not in `rating_actions.csv`. Confirmations ("affirms ... stable outlook", 2013-04-26, 2017-10-06, 2020-11-06) and the 2018-05-25 review for downgrade are excluded by the file's definition (changes only).
- `fitch_italy_long_term_idr_history.csv`: the Long Term Issuer Default Rating history panel on https://www.fitchratings.com/entity/italy-80442199. `outlook_after` is the outlook in force after the action (read from the `frw-RO*` span next to the rating; blank = none shown). Outlook changes are read by comparing consecutive rows. Not in `rating_actions.csv`: Rating Watch rows (2006-05-25, 2011-12-16), the unclear 2005-12-14 "Revision IDR", and everything before the study window starts in 2011 (2005-06-29 outlook stable to negative; 2006-10-19 downgrade AA to AA-).
- `dbrs_italy_long_term_foreign_currency_history.csv`: Morningstar DBRS, Italy (issuer 17689), Long-Term Foreign Currency Issuer Rating as returned by the public site's API on 2026-10-15 (`/api/issuer/documents` for the document list, `/api/document/rating-view?document_id=<id>` for the rating, trend and action of each document; rating reports 2011-2026 plus four press releases for the downgrades that have no rating report of their own: 2011-11-09, 2012-08-08, 2013-03-07 and the 2015-03-27 trend change). `date_issued` is the DBRS action date. Not in `rating_actions.csv`: "under review with negative implications" (2012-05-22, 2016-08-05), the 2011-02-03 first rating (before the study window) and confirmations. The Long-Term Local Currency rating always moves with it.
- `sp_italy_credit_news_titles.csv`: S&P Global Ratings, Italy entity page, table "Related Credit News and Research" (two saved pages, 2026-10-15; the table mixes the sovereign with banks, regions, utilities and recaps, so only the sovereign rating-action titles are kept, 1998-2026, with the time as shown on the page). Dates are the publication dates shown by S&P. Ratings and outlooks come from the titles. Not in `rating_actions.csv`: confirmations, the 2011-12-05 CreditWatch Negative, everything before 2011-09-19 (2011-05-20 outlook to negative, 2006-10-19 downgrade to A+, 2004 and 2005 rows). The 2013 downgrade is listed through its correction ("S&PCORRECT", 2013-07-10 13:41 EDT), which is the action date used (confirmed by the owner); an aggregator's 2013-07-09 is not used.
